entries.name: buck_tps62840
entries.note: 1-IC buck (TPS628436DRL, bundled sister of TPS62840). Agent-shaped rails: is_port on VIN/VOUT/GND, FB divider, EN pull-up. Exercises the single-IC pin-anchored path.

entries.name: mcu_rp2040
entries.note: Dense 56-pin MCU decoupling: 8 same-role 100nF caps + bulk on one +3V3 net, RUN pull-up. Stresses same-role cohort placement and long supply fan-out.

entries.name: ldo_ap2112k
entries.note: Real agent output (parse_datasheet -> design_spec -> netlist_synth), captured 2026-06-16. AP2112K LDO, in+out cap. Resolves to the bundled AP2112K-1.2 symbol; exercises a no-connect marker (pin 4) and an exposed EN port the hand-authored fixtures don't.
